title: Sugar beans grown with Grow Plus top dressing (Chikombedzi)
summary: Field result shared on the old site’s blog: sugar beans in Chikombedzi cultivated using only Grow Plus as a top dressing.
bodyHtml: Only Grow Plus as a top dressing was used to cultivate these sugar beans all the way in Chikombedzi (we had to consult google mams to find the place 😇😊🧐). Grow Plus is our organic biostimulant renowned for its ability to enhance soil and crop health
outcome: Only Grow Plus as a top dressing was used to cultivate these sugar beans (verbatim claim from the post; no yield figures published).
